##https://jayrobwilliams.com/posts/2020/09/jekyll-html

library(tidyverse)
library(tidygeocoder)
library(leaflet)
library(htmlwidgets)

museums <- read_csv('~/Downloads/museums.csv')

museums %>% mutate(label_text=str_c(name, str_c('Visited ',date), address,
                     str_c('<a href="', website, '" target="_blank">website</a>'),
                     sep = '<br>'))  %>% # paste fields into popup text
  leaflet() %>% # create leaflet map widget
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>% # add muted palette basemap
  addMarkers(lng = ~ long, lat = ~ lat, popup = ~ label_text) %>% # add markers with popup text
  saveWidget('museum_map.html') # save map widget
